title: Phi criterion: reference implementation
description: Reference implementation, derived tables and figures for a dimensionless testability criterion for geophysical claims: Phi = 2.802 sigma_d / (claim * sqrt(n_eff)) = MDE80 / claim, the ratio of the 80 % verification floor of an observational archive to the accuracy an assessment asserts. The archive reproduces every table, figure and headline number in the accompanying manuscript from fixed inputs and downloads no observational data.
notes: Author names and affiliations are placeholders and must be completed before publication. The article DOI is assigned by the journal; this record covers the software archive.
